lines.speaker: The Lord Ruler
lines.text: You climbed out of my pit. Nobody climbs out of my pit. I find I'm almost pleased; it has been a long time since anything surprised me.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: You killed him in front of everyone. You wanted them to see.

lines.speaker: The Lord Ruler
lines.text: I wanted them to remember. They will. You carry a great deal of metal for someone who has come to argue with me, child.
